key_insight: GANet targets plant disease identification on low-power hardware using a lightweight group-attention architecture.
engineering_relevance: Its compact design supports embedded crop monitoring where memory and processing resources are limited.
method: Group Equivariance Attention Network for 38 plant disease categories.
Novel Group Attention and Group-Wise Feature Fusion blocks.
Edge deployment on Raspberry Pi 4b and Jetson Nano.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 99.99% accuracy on PlantVillage with 0.001M parameters, plus inference rates of 5 FPS on Raspberry Pi 4b and 11 FPS on Jetson Nano.
watch_item: Field robustness remains unestablished in the abstract; PlantVillage accuracy may not transfer to variable lighting, backgrounds, and disease presentations.
paper_title: GANet: A Lightweight Group Attention Network for Plant Disease Identification on Embedded Systems
